[LSTO.4.5.2] **Cross-restart durability — an integration hook,
opt-in.** The engine's cache is in-memory, so a restart cold-starts
it empty. Surviving a restart is the `cache_write_through` shape
([LSTO.4.3.2]): the integration persists writes and hydrates the
cache on startup. Under the default volatile shape the cache does not
survive a restart, and rules must not assume a pre-restart key is
present (a miss reads as `null`, [LSTO.4.3.1a]).
